_comment: QCrypt 2026 presenters inferred from the YouTube recordings (channel @QCrypt2026-OttawaCanada), 2026-10-29. Evidence: title_slide_* = the opening slide (viewed in Chrome) marks the presenter (bold / underline / only name on the slide); caption_* = YouTube auto-captions (chair intro, self-intro, or exclusion via 'joint work with ...'). Applied to talks.csv by tools/one_off/conf2026/apply_qcrypt_2026_video_speakers.py. An empty speaker means it could not be determined. youtube_id may differ from the id video_pass.py picked only for duplicates noted here.
